2608.26053.title: $R^3$: Training Robots to Reason in Natural Language via Reinforcement Learning
2608.26053.paper_summary: Reasoning in language allows foundation models to spend more test-time compute on hard problems, such as those requiring decomposition, constraint tracking, and prediction of future consequences. Whether this mechanism can improve robotic manipulation remains unclear, where long-horizon tasks require tracking partial progress, reasoning about object relations, recovering from mistakes, and steering noisy low-level policies. In this paper, we study whether VLMs can be trained to reason directly in natural language to guide low-level manipulation policies. We introduce $R^3$, a simple post-training recipe that turns off-the-shelf VLMs into robotic reasoners: it first mid-trains a VLM on expert-generated reasoning traces to initialize the desired reasoning style, then improves the reasoner with single-step rubric-based RL from offline action data. Unlike prior robotic reasoning methods that mostly use structured traces as auxiliary supervision, $R^3$ trains free-form language reasoning to produce test-time guidance for action. We instantiate $R^3$ on Language Table and simulated bimanual grocery packing, two controlled testbeds for studying robotic reasoning and long-horizon manipulation. $R^3$ improves exploration and generalization across unseen tasks and significantly outperforms instruction-only imitation learning baselines on both benchmarks. Our analyses suggest that free-form language reasoning can function as a test-time compute mechanism for steering low-level policies. Our project page is available at https://robotic-reasoner.github.io/.
2608.26053.paper_summary_zh: 語言中的推理使基礎模型能夠在困難問題上花費更多的測試時間計算，例如那些需要分解、約束追蹤和預測未來後果的問題。這種機制是否能改善機器人操作仍不清楚，因為長期任務需要追蹤部分進展、推理物體關係、從錯誤中恢復以及引導嘈雜的低階策略。在本文中，我們研究了 VLM 是否可以直接用自然語言進行推理，以指導低階操作策略。我們介紹了 $R^3$，這是一個簡單的後訓練配方，將現成的 VLM 轉變為機器人推理器：它首先在專家生成的推理痕跡上中訓練 VLM，以初始化所需的推理風格，然後通過離線行動數據的單步標準化強化學習來改進推理器。與之前主要使用結構化痕跡作為輔助監督的機器人推理方法不同，$R^3$ 訓練自由形式的語言推理，以產生行動的測試時間指導。我們在語言表和模擬雙手雜貨包裝上實現了 $R^3$，這是研究機器人推理和長期操作的兩個受控測試平台。$R^3$ 在未見任務上改善了探索和泛化，並在這兩個基準上顯著超越了僅基於指令的模仿學習基線。我們的分析表明，自由形式的語言推理可以作為引導低階策略的測試時間計算機制。我們的項目頁面可在 https://robotic-reasoner.github.io/ 獲得。
